answer: Nebula Harberger-tax bond: each identity claims a nebula plot, self-prices it, locks a 70-credit bond, and takes an umber stamp. A delta tax of 6 is due each epoch; anyone may buy it at its self-price, so under-pricing loses it, over-pricing bleeds. Forging 1,000 needs a rented-plot ring: first 40, kth 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 cost 3,037,000+70,000 locked, 6,000 tax each epoch, vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents hold one plot, pay 40 once; it returns.
